G59.gig_title: Croissant and Viennoiserie Line Review for a Cafe Chain
G59.short_description: Looking for a pastry adviser to review the croissant and viennoiserie line of a Singapore cafe chain's central bakery, which supplies 18 outlets every morning. Quality has become uneven, with flat croissants, poor layering and short shelf life by afternoon. The adviser would review recipes, butter and flour choices, lamination, proofing and baking, observe two production nights, and recommend changes to recipes, process and timing. The adviser should also advise how outlets should store and refresh products during the day. Deliverable: a review report with recipe and process recommendations and an outlet handling guide. Engagement duration: 2-3 weeks.

G60.gig_title: Copy-editing a Pharmaceutical Engineering Procedures Manual
G60.short_description: Need a technical proofreader to copy-edit a 300-page engineering and maintenance procedures manual that a Singapore engineering consultancy has written for a pharmaceutical client's new plant. The manual covers utilities, clean rooms, HVAC and equipment maintenance. The editor would correct language and consistency, check numbering, tables, units and cross-references, apply the client's document template, and list unclear steps for the authors to resolve. The manual must be ready for the client's quality review. Deliverable: a copy-edited manual in the client template with tracked changes and a query list. Engagement duration: 4 weeks.

G61.gig_title: Independent Review of a Delayed Vessel Conversion
G61.short_description: Need a marine project management adviser to give a Singapore consulting firm an independent view of a delayed offshore vessel conversion it is overseeing for a client. The adviser would review the yard schedule, progress reports, change orders and the yard's recovery plan, visit the vessel, and advise on whether the new completion date is realistic and what the owner should press for. Deliverable: an independent review memo with recommendations. Engagement duration: 2 weeks.

G62.gig_title: Stage, Lighting and Sound for a Developer Conference
G62.short_description: Looking for a technical theatre specialist to run the stage, lighting and sound for a Singapore software company's two-day developer conference with about 600 attendees in a hotel ballroom. The specialist would design the stage and lighting plot, specify sound for keynotes and panels, coordinate with the live-stream crew, manage the hired crew and equipment, and run the shows during both days. Keynotes include live coding demos that need clear screens and reliable audio. Deliverable: stage and lighting plots, a cue sheet and two delivered conference days. Engagement duration: 2 weeks.

G63.gig_title: English to Chinese Translation of Site Security Rules
G63.short_description: A Singapore construction company employs many workers from China on its building sites, and its site security and access rules are only in English. It needs a translator to turn the 40-page site security handbook, the visitor and access forms and 20 safety and security signs into simplified Chinese. The translation must be accurate and easy for workers to understand, using terms that workers actually use on site, and the translator should check the final printed signs and forms. Deliverable: a translated handbook, forms and sign texts, with a bilingual glossary. Engagement duration: 2-3 weeks.

G64.gig_title: New Service Concept Design for Building Owners
G64.short_description: A Singapore engineering services firm designs and maintains building services for office and hospital owners and wants to develop a new subscription service built on sensor data from client buildings. It needs an innovation designer to run discovery interviews with eight client building managers, map their maintenance problems, prototype two or three service concepts with the firm's engineers, and test them with clients before management decides. Deliverable: discovery findings, tested service prototypes and a recommendation on which concept to build. Engagement duration: 2 weeks.

G65.short_description: A Singapore household products retailer wants to launch its own brand of plant-based cleaning liquids. It needs a chemical product development specialist to formulate four products, a dishwashing liquid, a floor cleaner, a multi-surface spray and a laundry liquid, with its chosen contract manufacturer, run stability and cleaning performance tests, and prepare product specifications and safety data sheets. The products must meet NEA rules on household cleaning products and the retailer's own green claims policy. Deliverable: four approved formulations, test reports, specifications and safety data sheets. Engagement duration: 4 weeks.
G65.additional_notes: Contract manufacturer already appointed; first production run planned for the following month.

G66.gig_title: Chinese Translation of a Heritage Walk Festival Guide

The translator should also check the designed pages before printing. Deliverable: translated volunteer guide and visitor brochure, checked in final layout. Engagement duration: 4 weeks.

G68.gig_title: Chinese Translation of a Production Tracking App

Deliverable: translated string files, a translated manual and a bilingual glossary. Engagement duration: 4-6 weeks.

G69.gig_title: Remote Working and IT Security Handbook Section

It should cover working from home, use of personal devices, handling client data under PDPA, password and phishing rules, and how to report incidents, in plain English for staff who are not technical. Deliverable: a finished handbook section of about 10 pages and a one-page summary. Engagement duration: 4-6 weeks.

G70.gig_title: Town Gas Safety Inspection at a Hospital Kitchen and Laundry

G74.gig_title: Room and Event Sales Plan for a Marina Clubhouse Hotel

G77.gig_title: Tender Deck Redesign for a Waste Logistics Company

G77.additional_notes: Next tender submission is due in three weeks.

G78.gig_title: Branch Signage and In-branch Brand Materials Refresh
G78.short_description: A Singapore bank is refreshing the look of its 20 retail branches after a brand update. G79.gig_title: Grounds Maintenance Review for a Technology Campus
G79.short_description: We are a Singapore technology company with a campus of four buildings, green roofs, lawns and planted courtyards. Deliverable: a grounds condition and contractor review, a revised maintenance specification and a recommendation. Engagement duration: 4 weeks.

G80.short_description: A Singapore furniture manufacturer has filmed 20 short product videos for its website and showrooms. Deliverable: 20 finished videos in web and screen formats. Engagement duration: 1-2 weeks.

G81.gig_title: Job Descriptions for a New Facilities Management Arm
G81.short_description: I run a Singapore construction group that is setting up a facilities management arm, and I need someone to write job descriptions for its 14 roles, from technicians and supervisors to a contract manager and a help desk team. Engagement duration: 6-8 weeks.

G82.gig_title: Airside Delivery Plan for Duty-free Stores
G82.short_description: We run duty-free shops in the transit areas of a Singapore airport and are moving to overnight deliveries to restock our 12 airside stores. Deliverable: a member readiness assessment, a market shortlist and a trip programme. Engagement duration: 3-4 weeks.

G84.gig_title: Maintenance Contract and Planning Review for Public Buildings
G84.short_description: I run the facilities division of a Singapore statutory board with 12 office and community buildings, and our maintenance is spread across nine contracts with uneven results. Deliverable: a review report, a preventive maintenance plan, contractor measures and a contracting recommendation. Engagement duration: 2 weeks.

G85.gig_title: Confidentiality and IP Section of a Staff Handbook
G85.short_description: A Singapore design consultancy with about 80 staff works on confidential products for clients and wants a clear staff handbook section on confidentiality and intellectual property. Deliverable: a finished handbook section of about 8 pages and a one-page summary. Engagement duration: 1-2 weeks.

G86.gig_title: Reefer Shipping Review for a Frozen Seafood Importer
G86.short_description: I run a Singapore frozen seafood importer bringing in about 60 reefer containers a month from Norway, Chile and Vietnam. I need a shipping specialist to review our carrier contracts and bookings, set up a single shipment tracking and documentation process, check reefer monitoring and claims handling, and train our team to run it. Deliverable: a shipping review, a tracking and documentation process and a trained team. Engagement duration: 2 weeks.

G87.gig_title: Transcripts and Summaries of Sustainability Stakeholder Interviews
G87.short_description: A Singapore energy company is preparing its first sustainability report and has recorded 15 stakeholder interviews with investors, customers, community groups and staff, about 20 hours of audio in total. The summaries will feed the company's materiality assessment, so they must be faithful to what was said. Deliverable: full transcripts and 15 one-page summaries. Engagement duration: 1-2 weeks.

G88.gig_title: Three-year Maintenance Forecast for a Turboprop Fleet

The plan should be easy for the firm to update monthly. Deliverable: a three-year maintenance forecast, a heavy check plan and a cost forecast. Engagement duration: 1-2 weeks.

G89.gig_title: Psychological Assessments for a Hospital Pain Clinic
G89.short_description: Need a psychologist to carry out psychological assessments and short pain coping sessions for about 15 patients referred by a Singapore hospital's pain clinic while its staff psychologist is on leave. The work covers assessing mood, sleep and coping, delivering two to four sessions per patient, writing reports for the pain specialists, and joining the weekly case meeting. Deliverable: assessments, sessions and reports for each referred patient. Engagement duration: 2-3 weeks.

G90.gig_title: Navigation Electronics Installation on Harbour Craft
G90.short_description: Looking for an electronics technician to install and commission navigation electronics on three Singapore harbour craft, including radar, ECDIS, AIS and VHF radio. The vessels run daily passenger and supply trips, so work must be planned tightly around each vessel's time out of service, and the crews will need a short handover on using the new equipment. Deliverable: installed and tested systems on three vessels, as-fitted drawings and inspection support. Engagement duration: 6-8 weeks.
G90.additional_notes: Vessels can only be taken out of service one at a time.

G91.gig_title: Maintenance Methodology for a Port Rail Line Bid

It needs a rail engineer to review the asset condition data in the tender, prepare the maintenance methodology, inspection regime and staffing plan for the bid, estimate resources and spares, and advise on the technical risks to price in. The engineer would work with the firm's bid team and attend one clarification meeting with the client. Deliverable: a maintenance methodology, staffing and resource plan and a technical risk register for the bid. Engagement duration: 4 weeks.

G92.gig_title: Customer List Clean-up for a Medical Nutrition Company
G92.short_description: A Singapore medical nutrition company sells specialised formulas to about 1,200 hospitals, clinics and pharmacies in Singapore and Malaysia. Deliverable: a cleaned customer list, a change log and a list of flagged accounts. Engagement duration: 3-4 weeks.

G93.gig_title: First Sustainability Report for a Listed Logistics Subsidiary

The work must follow SGX sustainability reporting rules and be ready for the parent's internal review. Deliverable: a checked data set, a GRI content index and drafted report sections. Engagement duration: 2-3 weeks.

G94.gig_title: Construction Coordination for a Campus Sports Pavilion
G94.short_description: A Singapore international school is building a two-storey sports pavilion on its campus during term time. G95.gig_title: Building a Distributor Channel for IoT Sensors

Deliverable: signed distributors in at least three countries and first orders placed. Engagement duration: 6-8 weeks.

G96.gig_title: Learning System and CPD Tracking Review for an Accounting Firm
G96.short_description: I run a Singapore accounting firm with about 150 staff, and our learning management system and CPD tracking are not working well. Deliverable: a review report with recommended changes. Engagement duration: 2 weeks.

G97.gig_title: Programme Review for a Regional Distribution Hub Consolidation
G97.short_description: A Singapore electronics manufacturer is moving its regional distribution from three warehouses in Singapore, Malaysia and Thailand to one hub in Singapore. It needs a logistics programme adviser to review the network design, the move plan, inventory transfer and customer service risks, and the programme governance, and to advise management on whether the timeline is realistic and what to change. The adviser would interview the programme team and the warehouse operator and review the business case. Deliverable: a programme review with recommendations and a risk register. Engagement duration: 4-6 weeks.

G98.gig_title: Coffee and Tea Programme for a Social Enterprise Cafe Chain
G98.short_description: I run a Singapore social enterprise with four cafes that employ persons with disabilities, and our coffee and tea quality varies from cafe to cafe. The expert should also train two senior baristas to coach others after the engagement. Deliverable: a beverage programme, set-up equipment, visual recipe cards and trained baristas and coaches. Engagement duration: 3-4 weeks.

G99.gig_title: Quality Training Deck Redesign for an Energy Company Lab
G99.short_description: I run the quality team at a Singapore energy company's fuel testing laboratory, and our 30-slide quality training deck for new staff is cluttered and hard to follow. I need a presentation designer to restructure it, turn procedures into clear diagrams and checklists, apply our corporate template and add speaker notes. Deliverable: a redesigned training deck with speaker notes. Engagement duration: 2 weeks.

G100.gig_title: Stability and Layout Review for a Supply Vessel Conversion
G100.short_description: Need a naval design engineer to review a proposal to convert a 45-metre offshore supply vessel into a crew transfer vessel for a Singapore operator. The engineer would check the stability calculations for the new loading conditions, review the general arrangement, seating and escape routes, and advise on the class and flag requirements that apply. Deliverable: a design review report with comments on stability, arrangement and compliance. Engagement duration: 3-4 weeks.
